decisions.reason: Product D builds closely on the firm's established GIS offer and is presented as a flagship, so the firm's own R&D allows it to interpret results, learn, and improve it, making a drop unlikely.
Product E is close to the firm's established mobile GIS solutions, and with in-house R&D the firm can assimilate new information and refine the product, so it is likely kept.
Product F is close to the firm's existing web map search extensions and has shown active version development, which fits the firm's absorptive capacity to learn and improve rather than drop.
